headline: Hacker behind 2022 GTA VI leaks pleads guilty
summary: Lapsus$ member Arion Kurtaj pleaded guilty to leaking Grand Theft Auto VI videos. He also hacked other major companies. Kurtaj is now 21 years old.

headline: Tech leaders are convinced that Jensen Huang’s exit was a plot against him
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation after 33 years shocked the tech industry. Prominent figures are demanding his reinstatement. A theory suggests his exit was a plot against him.

headline: United Airlines system outage disrupts departures just days after the big ground stop
summary: United Airlines experienced a system outage disrupting departing flights. This occurred less than a week after a nationwide FAA ground stop. The issue has since been fixed.

headline: In Get Huge, the manosphere is here to make friends — with deadly consequences
summary: The documentary "Get Huge" explores the manosphere's rise and its dangerous impact. It focuses on influencers promoting chemical biohacking and extreme self-modification. This content often leads to deadly consequences.

headline: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey Comes to Digital With Over 90 Minutes of Bonus Features
summary: Christopher Nolan's "The Odyssey" is now available digitally. The release includes over 90 minutes of exclusive bonus features. Fans can delve deeper into the acclaimed film.

headline: There Really Is No Escape From The Duolingo Owl, Who Will Soon Join Pokémon Go
summary: Duolingo's iconic owl mascot, Duo, is expanding its reach. Duo will soon appear in the popular mobile game Pokémon Go. Prepare for language lessons to follow you everywhere.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Re-Release With New Footage Sets December Release Date, Tickets on Sale This Week
summary: Marvel Studios is re-releasing "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" this December. The re-release promises new footage and additional surprises. Tickets for the cinematic event go on sale this week.

headline: The 'Next James Bond' Actors Who Never Played James Bond
summary: Many actors have been falsely rumored as the "next James Bond." Only seven actors have officially portrayed 007. This list explores those who almost took the iconic role.

headline: The young people caught up in Britain's Neets crisis
summary: Britain faces a "Neets crisis" with a million young people out of work or education. The BBC speaks to 16-24 year olds affected. They share their experiences of unemployment and disengagement.

headline: How Met failed to stop rape-unit detective who abused women
summary: A Metropolitan Police detective, Warren Arter, abused women using his position. He led a team investigating sexual assaults. The Met repeatedly missed chances to stop his predatory behavior.

headline: Watch: How predatory Met detective's behaviour became increasingly extreme
summary: BBC Panorama reveals the escalating predatory behavior of Det Insp Warren Arter. The Metropolitan Police failed to intervene despite multiple opportunities. Arter abused his authority within the rape unit.

headline: Cass report author says she does not support draft conversion practices bill
summary: The author of the Cass gender care review opposes the draft conversion practices bill. She warns of "serious unintended consequences." Concerns are raised for parents and therapists.
